tfn.s: The activities are designed to fit inside a normal meal.
tfn.why: The text says: “The activities have time limits so they can sit comfortably within a lunch or dinner, rather than turning the whole meal into an organised event.”

tfn.s: The results of the pilot were published when the scheme was announced.

tfn.s: Restaurants already place other kinds of rules on their customers.
